corrections.was: level 0 of the impact-to-damage chain is 007BBCF0, the unit instance's entity-side hit response, producer unread
corrections.is: 007BBCF0 is the plane family's vtable[ECh] override (nine vtables, class ids 0F..17). The unit instance vtable 00CFC3D0 that docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_LAYOUT.md gives for MDestroyer carries 00826F10 at +ECh, so a shell hit on a destroyer never enters 007BBCF0
corrections.evidence: scan-bytes of .rdata for each handler address; hit - 0xEC lands on a named vtable base every time, and ghidra xrefs 00826F10 returns exactly the nine ship vtables as DATA refs with no code ref

corrections.is: that holds for planes only; for a ship 008777D0 is the tail call of 00826F10 at 008277FC (PUSH ESI; MOV ECX,EDI; CALL 0x008777D0), so the base handler has two producers
corrections.evidence: the listing at 008277F9..008277FC, and 00826F10's Ghidra body 00826F10-0082781B contains it

corrections.was: hit+0Ch: negative selects the [unit+354h]->vtable[24h]() armour source
corrections.is: 008777D0 also gates that branch on this->vtable[5Ch](6) at 008777ED, so it applies only to class-06-derived entities; 00826F10 makes the same selection from [this+538h], the ref-counted pointer to the same descriptor, with no class test
corrections.evidence: 008777E8..00877819 in the listing, and 009553D0's setter MOV [ECX+0x538],EAX with the addref through [00CE221C]

corrections.was: the call site 00827450 has no Ghidra function; the enclosing candidate is 00826D70
corrections.is: the site is inside 00826F10, whose Ghidra body is 00826F10-0082781B

corrections.was: no in-engine producer of the fire or water timers was found; whether a hit can ignite a fire without script is an open question
corrections.is: 00826F10 sends message 9Eh on every hit that carries a weapon (channel 1, water) and on a probability roll (channel 0, fire). The channel mapping comes from the two Lua setters, which build the identical message: 0088E320 SetFireDamage loads 0 with XOR EBP,EBP at 0088E343 and 0088E790 SetWaterDamage loads 1 with MOV EBP,1 at 0088E7AF. The 9Eh handler itself is still contract: unread
corrections.evidence: scan-bytes "68 9e 00 00 00" --section .text returns exactly 0080FA51, 0088E4AC, 0088E919 (plus 00548AA7 in unrelated code); all three write vtable 00D0334C and the same field layout

corrections.was: 0080FFD0 is the local constructor for the message class whose vtable is 00D034C8. It has no callers in the image ... nothing in this image produces such a message locally; a hull body's only force and torque come from 009329C0's hydrodynamic model and 00937440's rudder term
corrections.is: 00826F10 produces one: 0080FFD0 at 00827312, routed by 0077C2A0(this, &msg, 7, 0) at 00827329. The producer is the torpedo roll torque, gated on the shot being 2Bh MTorpedo, the class Mass being above 500.0 and the session mode being 0 or 1. The earlier reading predates Ghidra having a function at 00826F10, so the call site sat in unrecognised bytes and no caller scan could see it
corrections.evidence: the listing 00827304..00827329 inside the Ghidra body 00826F10-0082781B, and python tools/bsp.py callees 00826f10, which lists 0080ffd0

the concrete class of weapon = shot->vtable[108h](), and whether its +10h/+14h/+18h floats are side-effect-free getters (the handler calls +10h and +14h twice each)
this+10D0h, cleared at 008270BE and never read in this packet
[[this+1018h]+2Ch]+20h, the roll axis: the producer of that field was not read, so 'the hull's forward axis' is inference from the cross product's shape
00827B90, the other caller of 0080FA50, was not read

tool_problems: python tools/bsp.py ghidra export <addr> --asm is not accepted; the assembly listing is produced by the plain export and reached through show --asm or the shared exports/bsp/functions/<addr>/assembly.txt
ghidra decompile caps near 80 lines, so the 2.3 KB body needed show --start paging plus the full 624-line listing copied to local/ and paged with sed

the pseudocode drops the ECX argument of every __thiscall helper: 0092D1F0's parts object (this+1018h), 0093BED0's repair task (this+A20h) and 0064B170's HUD widget all appear as free functions. Every ABI here was taken from the listing and the callee's RET n
